brief: How has Southeast Asia propylene moved since 2024?

sections.title: Southeast Asia Propylene Price Movement Since 2024
questions: What has been the monthly price movement for Southeast Asia propylene since January 2024?
Are there any notable trends, spikes, or declines in the available price series for this period?
How do contract and spot prices compare, and what is the coverage for each?
Are there any gaps or limitations in the price data for this period?
sections.tool_rationale: 'describe_corpus' to confirm the available price series and their coverage; 'query_price_series' to extract the actual monthly price data for Southeast Asia propylene (spot and contract); 'search_part_a_documents' to identify any commentary or explanations for significant price movements or trends.
sections.unanswerable_if: If neither the spot nor contract price series for Southeast Asia propylene covers any months since January 2024, or if all available months are blank or missing.

excluded.reason: The latest available price data for Southeast Asia propylene is August 2026 (contract) and December 2025 (spot); no forecast or post-August 2026 data is available.
